**Abstract:**

In this work, we mainly investigate effect of PT-symmetic operation on the dynamic behavior of the relative entropy of coherence for a two-level system within non-Markovian environments and put forward a feasible physical scheme to recover coherence by using PT-symmetric operator. We investigate the two-level system which consists of two levels, i.e. the ground state $\left|0\right\rangle $ and the excited state $\left|1\right\rangle $. When the two-level system interacts with the non-Markovian environment, the loss of coherence in the two-level system is observed. In order to keep the system away from the complete decoherence, we introduce a PT-symmetry operator. Under this PT-symmetry operation, we derive a set of differential equations of relative entropy of coherence which is used to describe the degree of coherence for the two-level system. In this paper, we discuss the analytic solution for a special case. By using the analytic solution, we obtain the relation between the loss of coherence and PT-symmetry parameter. By fitting the experimental data, we obtain the PT-symmetry parameter which we can use to recover the coherence for the two-level system. Through a non-trivial analysis, we conclude that the PT-symmetry operation can be used to reduce the loss of coherence in the two-level system.
